scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:assets && npm run build:bundle
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:plugin && npm run typecheck:pi
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run test:release-version && npm run security:dist && npm run check:pi-dist && npm run validate && npm run pack:check
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run verify && streamdeck pack com.esheep.switchbot.sdPlugin --no-update-check
scripts.test:release-version: node scripts/release-version.mjs v0.0.1-alpha1 && node scripts/release-version.mjs v0.0.1-beta1 && node scripts/release-version.mjs v0.0.1-rc1 && node scripts/release-version.mjs v0.0.1
